response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON CAST(o.recordvault AS TEXT) = CAST(f.orderslink AS TEXT)), pair_averages AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_rate) AS pair_avg FROM matched GROUP BY mktnote), overall AS (SELECT AVG(net_rate) AS overall_avg FROM matched) SELECT AVG(p.pair_avg) AS mean_pair_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.pair_avg - a.overall_avg) AS mean_excess FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE p.pair_avg > a.overall_avg;
